item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Deputy-involved shooting in Pasco County leaves one man dead following domestic violence call: PSO
item.description: A deputy-involved shooting in Pasco County left one man dead overnight following a domestic violence call in Land O' Lakes, according to the Pasco Sheriff's Office (PSO).
